name: JoAi: Update Site

description.en: Update a site’s enabled state, name, URL, custom domain, type (undefined|shop), contact, metrics source/resource, or monthly report schedule.
description.de: Aktualisiert Aktivierung, Name, URL, eigene Domain, Typ (undefined|shop), Kontakt, Metrik-Quelle/-Ressource oder Monatsbericht einer Website.

bot: Update site fields including optional type and custom domain. customDomain sets the site’s own bare hostname (e.g. example.com, no protocol) and must be unique across teams. type=shop requires url, only works on brandless sites, and marks this site as the post-checkout storefront return URL (one shop per team). Pass type=undefined (or empty) to clear shop. For metricsSource=analytics, pass analyticsDomains as the public hostname JSON array; metricsResource is optional because JoAi generates a site key when needed. For Cloudflare and Google Search Console, pass metricsResource as the zone tag or property URL. monthlyReport=true opts into the 1st-of-month job when contact and metrics are set — it does not send immediately. Native analytics needs no third-party integration. If another source returns channel_not_configured, call settings-integration-open with its integration, then retry.

description.en: Bare hostname without protocol, e.g. example.com. Must be unique across teams; omit to leave unchanged.
description.de: Nackter Hostname ohne Protokoll, z. B. example.com. Muss teamübergreifend eindeutig sein; weglassen, um ihn nicht zu ändern.

description.en: undefined = normal website/portfolio. shop = storefront return URL after checkout (brandless sites only).
description.de: undefined = normale Website/Portfolio. shop = Shop-URL nach Checkout (nur ohne Brand).

description.en: Provider resource identifier. Omit for analytics to let JoAi generate the private site key.
For analytics, allowed hostname JSON array, e.g. ["cafe-jordan.at"]
